sql: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(q),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT id,owner,owner_id,version,metadata->>'size' AS size,metadata->>'mimetype' AS mime,metadata->>'eTag' AS etag FROM storage.objects WHERE bucket_id='operation-evidence' AND name='ba40a958-0747-4751-9b33-b3326bf7b802/f2080f3e-063d-408a-89a6-8fcbc90ea210/prepare.png') q;
